_comment: Artistern Radar source registry. 'feeds' are machine-fetched via RSS/Atom by scripts/build_digest.py. 'manual_sources' have no usable feed and are rendered as a static check-manually list. 'social' is a static directory. See README.md for how to add or fix a source.
_window_note: 180 days. The regional institutions publish on a 2-6 month cadence (Delfina ~56d, Kamel Lazaar ~77d, 1-54 ~96d, Barjeel ~176d), so a shorter window keeps every one of them out of the digest and leaves only the daily Western art wires. Lower this if the page starts feeling stale rather than broad.
